caption: John says Jesus’s thirst fulfilled Scripture. Psalm 22 may be part of the meaning—but the sour wine points just as strongly to Psalm 69.

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Did Psalm 22 predict Jesus’s thirst? The psalmist’s mouth is painfully dry. John says Jesus declared, ‘I am thirsty,’ to fulfil Scripture.
slides.body: The psalmist’s mouth is painfully dry. John says Jesus declared, ‘I am thirsty,’ to fulfil Scripture.
slides.heading: Did Psalm 22 predict Jesus’s thirst?

slides.alt_text: The claimed New Testament fulfilment in Jn 19:28, BSB: After this, knowing that everything had now been accomplished, and to fulfill the Scripture, Jesus said, “I am thirsty.”
slides.body: After this, knowing that everything had now been accomplished, and to fulfill the Scripture, Jesus said, “I am thirsty.”
